ayahs.1: What are they asking one another about?
ayahs.6: Did We not make the earth a resting place,
ayahs.7: the mountains as pegs holding it steady,
ayahs.9: made sleep a rest for you,
ayahs.10: the night as a cover over you,
ayahs.11: the day for earning your livelihood,
ayahs.12: built above you seven strong heavens,
ayahs.13: placed a blazing lamp in them,
ayahs.14: and sent down pouring rain from rainclouds
ayahs.17: The Day of Decision is a fixed appointment—
ayahs.18: the Day the Trumpet is blown and you emerge in crowds,
ayahs.20: mountains blown away like a mirage.
ayahs.21: Hell lies in wait for the wicked—
ayahs.23: where they will remain for endless ages.
ayahs.24: They will taste neither coolness nor drink,
ayahs.25: except scalding water and oozing pus—
ayahs.26: a fitting reward for their deeds.
ayahs.27: They never expected to be held to account,
ayahs.28: and they rejected Our signs outright.
ayahs.30: They will be told, 'Taste this—there is only more torment from Us.'
ayahs.31: Those with taqwa will have true success—
ayahs.34: and cups brimming full for them,
ayahs.35: hearing no idle talk or lies there—
ayahs.36: a generous reward from your Rabb,
ayahs.37: Rabb of the heavens and earth and all between—the Rahman, whose mercy in this life extends over all creation. On that Day no one will dare speak to Him
ayahs.38: except those the Rahman permits—angels and the holy spirit standing in ranks, speaking only what is true.
ayahs.39: That Day is the ultimate truth. Let whoever wills take the path back to their Rabb.
ayahs.40: We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see what their hands sent forth, and those who reject the truth will cry, 'I wish I were dust!'
